decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already moves the connector to the main board and records its tap into PWRON at J_PWR_SIG pin 4; the other panel-power attributes were already established.
The new button taps the existing AXP2101 PWRON line and does not assign or change an ESP32-S3 GPIO.
The source adds a power-control connector and does not change the BOOT button, reset control, or timing capacitances.
The shared 2-pin JST-GH connector type is incidental; the source does not change the charge-status LED interface.
Adding a panel power-button connector does not alter the selected ESP32-S3 module or part number.
This Requirement concerns power-board BOM readiness, while the source explicitly places the new connector on the main board and makes no BOM decision.
The interboard interface already carries PWRON on signal-connector pin 4; tapping that existing line for a separate panel connector does not change its pinout or behavior.
PWRON power-button control is distinct from the ESP32-controlled 5V_EN boost-rail behavior.
The source adds a main-board panel control connector and does not change any sensor-board input or module connector.
The source concerns the PWRON line and does not change USB data routing, enumeration, or standalone programming.
The panel power-button connector is unrelated to the SPS30 connector, supply, and I2C-mode signals.
Message 439 only relocates the panel power-button connector; the DCDC1 voltage question is raised separately in message 440 and is not resolved by this source.
